candidates.title: LDD administrative permission record: 45, Whitechapel Road
candidates.summary: The London Development Database archive row for 45, Whitechapel Road in Tower Hamlets lists Current permission status 'Not started' and a source-supplied Permission Date of 2018-09-19. The row records 280 proposed bedrooms; 2061 sqm proposed floorspace. Source proposal description: Application for variation of condition to Planning Permission ref: PA/13/02162, dated 29/11/2013.
